_readme: Places OpenStreetMap doesn't carry, and corrections to places it carries wrongly.
Separate from hours-overlay.json on purpose: that file answers 'when is this open',
this one answers 'does this exist, and where'. Same discipline though — every entry
records where it came from and when it was checked, so a stale entry can be
Applied to public/data/skymap-data.json by scripts/apply-poi-overlay.mjs. Run it
after every `npm run data:osm`, alongside apply-hours-overlay.mjs — extraction
rewrites the dataset and would otherwise drop all of this.
`added` entries sit at their host building's centroid. We don't have a surveyed
point for them and inventing a plausible-looking one would be a fake precision;
the building is the honest answer and the only thing routing needs.
When OSM catches up with an entry, the script reports it as retirable rather than
emitting a duplicate. Retire it then — the upstream record is the better one.
Two independent sources are required before anything lands here, and the operator
wins on conflict. Hotel pages disagree with their own tenants: the Emery listed
Spyhouse as 6:30-5 daily while Spyhouse published 6:30-7 on Wed-Sun.

poi-x-spyhouse-emery.name: Spyhouse Coffee
poi-x-spyhouse-emery.note: The report that started this. Emery already carried Giulia, so a foodless-building sweep would never have found it.

poi-x-aurora-marriott-city-center.name: Aurora Restaurant & Bar
poi-x-aurora-marriott-city-center.note: 5th floor. Hours omitted: Aurora runs three services a day (06:30-10:30, 11:00-16:00, 17:00-23:00) and the app renders one interval per day, so the only recordable form would be 06:30-23:00 — which claims it is open across two gaps it is closed. The Marriott City Center is the building 1.7's feedback said was unmarked; it had no food POI either.

poi-x-mara-rbc-gateway.name: Mara
poi-x-mara-rbc-gateway.note: Hours deliberately absent — not published consistently enough to record. Omitted rather than guessed.

poi-x-123-sushi-ids-center.name: 123 Sushi
poi-x-123-sushi-ids-center.note: Hours not published by the operator; omitted rather than guessed.

poi-x-sushi-takatsu-733-building.name: Sushi Takatsu
poi-x-sushi-takatsu-733-building.note: Baker Center skyway level; our dataset names that building '733 Building' after its address.

_note: Named by the Meet Minneapolis skyway guide but not confirmed at a second source,
so deliberately NOT in the dataset. Listed here so the next pass starts from
what's already been tried rather than re-deriving it.
Broadway Pizza and JR Thai Food (U.S. Bank Plaza), Los Ocampos Express
(City Center / 50 South Sixth). Checked 2026-08-23.
Places the dataset carries that are not there any more. Removed at apply time
rather than edited out of skymap-data.json, which extraction rewrites.
A removal needs two sources and a re-check on the day it lands. Removing a real
place is worse than showing a dead one: a wrong removal is invisible, while a
dead pin at least gets reported.

poi-2387569338.name: The Seville
poi-2387569338.reason: Closed abruptly in March 2026; staff given hours to clear lockers. The club's own site still says 'temporarily closed', but five months on with no reopening, routing someone there is a wasted walk.

poi-11248557998.name: Midwest Motorcycle
poi-11248557998.reason: Minneapolis location closed; the operator kept its Myrtle Beach, Sturgis and Daytona stores and shut this one.

_note: Entries a 2026-08-07 curation pass recorded as broken which re-checking on
2026-08-23 found to be fine. Kept so the next pass doesn't delete them on the
strength of the old note. Four of the eight did not survive re-verification --
which is the argument for re-verifying rather than acting on a fortnight-old list.
poi-9219442092 FedEx Office (IDS Center): recorded as absent from FedEx's own
locator. It is not -- local.fedex.com lists 80 S 8th St Ste 180 with skyway
access, current as of July 2026. OPEN.
poi-6780251057 Dreamgirls: recorded as closed. Yelp carries current operating
hours (We-Sa evenings) as of May 2026. OPEN.
poi-13812237869 Trax: recorded as 'filed under Ford Center but 136 m away'. It
is 128 m from the centroid and outside the footprint -- and carries nearby:true,
so the app already says 'nearest skyway access' instead of claiming it is inside.
Working as designed, not a defect.
poi-12810525201 James & Mary Laurie Booksellers: sources disagree on the address.
ILAB and ABAA say 250 3rd Ave N Ste 115; Yelp says 933 Marquette. Also carries
nearby:true. Left in place pending a source that settles it -- not removed on a
conflict.
poi-5355792471 T-Mobile (IDS Center): not re-verified this pass. Left in place.
The Jack Link's duplicate was real and is fixed in dedupePois instead: identity
now ignores case and punctuation, so 'Jack Links' and "Jack Link's" collapse.
